title: _detect_country() false-positive on queries containing 'with '
symptom: Any query containing the word 'with' (e.g. 'what are rules with data protection?') incorrectly triggers a Thailand country detection, causing an unnecessary crawl attempt for TH.
root_cause: The keyword list included 'th ' (to catch the country code TH in queries). After .lower(), the substring 'th ' matches inside common English words like 'with ', 'health ', 'length '. Simple substring matching has no word-boundary awareness.
fix: Removed 'th ' from the keyword list in _detect_country(). Thailand is already covered by 'thailand', 'thai', 'ไทย', and 'pdpa' — all of which are unambiguous.
